properties.description: A write lands in the attached design ONLY — two designs open simultaneously in one process, written to in interleaved turns, and each store proven to contain only its own nodes; plus the two properties that half rests on: the STORE is the isolation boundary rather than the id (naming another design's graph_id from a different store serves nothing and writes nothing into it), and a reopen re-attaches to the same design even with a different design opened first and still held. NARROWED 2026-08-07 (epoch:isolation-check-scope-split): this node previously also claimed "a graph_id it was not attached to is REFUSED rather than served" and "a path is not an alternative route in", and was set PASSING while no test could reach either — both need a surface on which a session NAMES a design, and cmp:registry is planned. Those two clauses are now ver:a-session-cannot-name-another-design, which is PLANNED and says so. dec:one-process-many-stores was accepted conditional on ALL FOUR, so its condition is HALF MET, and the graph now computes that instead of resting on a comment in a test file.
properties.name: A write lands in the attached design only, and the store is the boundary
